top.line: Know the Reach was made with AI and by a person: Silvio Switha, whose twenty years as a musician shaped every choice.
top.para: AI changed how fast he could hear his ideas, not who had them; the version he chose is why people connect with it.

in-short.line: The person, the experience, the speed, what the numbers miss, the chosen version, and the loop.

tonight.line: Of all the songs we could have played last night, we chose this one.
tonight.para: The audit's numbers are true, but they tell the usual story, that a machine made it.

silvio.line: One of the best musicians I know, a singer and producer with one of the Algarve's most successful wedding bands.
silvio.para: Every hour he spent carried twenty years of experience; the tool amplifies what you bring.

lyrics.line: The lyrics came from a session holding RiskMandate's history and his guidance.
lyrics.para: The chorus, the structure and the pacing are his decisions.

producer.line: Produced music is prescribed from the top; Silvio was the producer, with immediate feedback.
producer.para: He stayed in flow and tried hundreds of variations, at a budget a start-up has.

numbers.line: The audit's figures are perhaps a fifth of the work.
numbers.para: They count what was saved, not the listening, the dropped variations or the twenty years.

chosen.line: When anything can be generated, the version someone chose is worth more.
chosen.para: People relate to the story, the video and the team behind it.

loop.line: The next step closes the loop: the same song recorded by his band.
loop.para: Artists will experiment with AI as bands always tried songs live and in the studio, only faster.

board.line: A song about governance and the board that you want to play again.
board.para: RiskMandate now has two songs on Spotify.

limits.line: A view from someone who was there, an estimate, and a challenge, not a plan.

sources.line: My own account, the production audit, the song and the video.
sources.para: With links to the first article and the Ten days hub.
